novelty.justification: The claim predicts that developmental lineages form "continuous, low-curvature trajectories," with branch points matching biological bifurcations and direction aligned with differentiation rather than batch variation; its novelty route is therefore a more detailed geometric and mechanistic characterization of pretrained single-cell-model representations. Searches for "single-cell foundation model developmental trajectory latent embedding," "scGPT Geneformer RNA velocity lineage," and "foundation model embedding branch topology batch effect" identified TranscriptFormer (Science, 2026) as the closest work because it already reports that developmental trajectories and cellular hierarchies emerge naturally in foundation-model representations, while DTNE (PNAS, 2025) and BLTSA (Bioinformatics, 2023) already supply geodesic-preserving and branching-manifold analyses for single-cell data. Moving to explicit curvature, velocity alignment, batch-axis separation, and lineage-feature ablation is a substantive multi-step operationalization but remains a natural extension and combination of those established directions rather than a new core relationship or measurement paradigm.
